verses.en: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, wherein Solomon had built the house of the LORD, and his own house,
verses.sm: Solomona; ma lona tofia o vasega o faitaulaga Ua mavae tausaga e luafulu na fai ai e Solomona le fale o le ALII ma lona lava fale.

verses.en: That the cities which Huram had restored to Solomon, Solomon built them, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.
verses.sm: O aai foi na tuuina mai e Hiramo ia Solomona ua toe faia e Solomona, ma na faanonofo ai le fanauga a Isaraelu.

verses.en: And Solomon went to Hamath-zobah, and prevailed against it.
verses.sm: Ua alu atu foi Solomona i Amato-sopa, ma ua manumalo ai.

verses.en: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the store cities, which he built in Hamath.
verses.sm: Ua fai foi e ia o Tatemora i le vao, ma aai uma e tuu ai oloa na ia faia i Amato.

verses.en: Also he built Beth-horon the upper, and Beth-horon the nether, fenced cities, with walls, gates, and bars;
verses.sm: Ua faia foi e ia o Peteorana i luga, ma Peteorana i lalo, o aai nofo ‘olo, ua i ai pa, ma puipui, ma faamaufaalava;

verses.en: And Baalath, and all the store cities that Solomon had, and all the chariot cities, and the cities of the horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and throughout all the land of his dominion.
verses.sm: o Paalata foi, ma aai uma sa ia Solomona e tuu ai oloa, ma aai uma mo kariota, ma aai mo e tietie i solofanua, ma mea uma na finagalo i ai Solomona e fai i Ierusalema, ma Lepanona, ma nuu uma ua pule ai o ia.

verses.en: As for all the people that were left of the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which were not of Israel,
verses.sm: O tagata uma na totoe o sa Heti, ma sa Amori, ma sa Perisē, ma sa Hivi, ma sa Iepusē, e le ni Isaraelu i latou,

verses.en: But of their children, who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel consumed not, them did Solomon make to pay tribute until this day.
verses.sm: o a latou fanau na totoe i le nuu, ina ua mavae i latou, o e na le faaumatia e le fanauga a Isaraelu, na pule Solomona ia te i latou ia fai taulaga, ua oo lava i ona po nei.

verses.en: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for his work; but they were men of war, and chief of his captains, and captains of his chariots and horsemen.
verses.sm: A ua le faia e Solomona ni o le fanauga a Isaraelu ma pologa e fai ai lana galuega; a o tagata tau i latou, ma alii ave “au, ma alii e pule i ana kariota, ma ana “an tietie i solofanua.

verses.en: And these were the chief of king Solomon's officers, even two hundred and fifty, that bare rule over the people.
verses.sm: O alii ia e na tofia e le tupu o Solomona e pule, e lua selau ma le toalimagafulu, o i latou na pule i le nuu.

verses.en: And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of David unto the house that he had built for her: for he said, My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because the places are holy, whereunto the ark of the LORD hath come.
verses.sm: Ua avae e Solomona le afafine o Farao mai le aai a Tavita i le fale na ia faia mo ia; auā ua faapea mai o ia, E le nofo laʻu avā i le fale o Tavita le tupu o Isaraelu, auā e paia le mea ua au mai i ai le atolaau a le ALII.

verses.en: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings unto the LORD on the altar of the LORD, which he had built before the porch,
verses.sm: Ona fai lea e Solomona o tawada mu i le ALII i luga o le fata faitaulaga o le ALn na faia e iai luma o le faapaologa,

verses.en: Even after a certain rate every day, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts, three times in the year, even in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.
verses.sm: o le aso ma le mea e fai taulaga a'i e tusa ma le poloaiga a Mose, e fai i sapati, ma masina faatoa vaaia, ma faapotopotoga e taiatutolu i tausaga, o le tausamiga o le areto e le faafefeteina, ma le tausamiga o vaiasosa, ma le tausamiga o fale apitaga.

verses.en: And he appointed, according to the order of David his father, the courses of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their charges, to praise and minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required: the porters also by their courses at every gate: for so had David the man of God commanded.
verses.sm: Ua tofia foi e ia e tusa ma le tofiga a Tavita lona tamà, o vasega o le au faitaulaga i a latou galuega, ma sa Levi i o latou tofi, e vivii ma auauna i luma o le au faitaulaga, o le aso ma le mea e fai ai; o leoleo faitotoa foi i o latou vasega i lea faitotoa ma lea faitotoa; aua sa faapea le poloaiga a Tavita le tagata o le Atua.

verses.en: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.
verses.sm: Ua le tuua le fetalaiga a le tupu i le au faitaulaga, ma sa Levi, i mea uma lava, atoa ma le oloa.

verses.en: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of the LORD, and until it was finished. So the house of the LORD was perfected.
verses.sm: O galuega uma a Solomona sa saunia, ua oo i le aso na tuu ai le faavae O le fale o le ALII e 00 foi i le aso na uma ai. Ua faaumaina ona fai o le fale o le ALII.

verses.en: Then went Solomon to Ezion-geber, and to Eloth, at the sea side in the land of Edom.
verses.sm: Ona alu atu lea o Solomona i Esiokape ma Elata i le matafaga o le sami i le nuu o Etoma.

verses.en: And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships, and servants that had knowledge of the sea; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and took thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought them to king Solomon.
verses.sm: Ua aumaia e Hiramo ia te ia i lima o ana auauna o vaa, ma ona tagata ua masani ma le sami; ua latou o faatasi ma auauna a Solomona
